column6: Say I want to ask Mei Ling to be my donee.
column8: Say I want to ask May Ling to be my doh-nee.

column6: Mei Ling, will you be my donee?
column8: May Ling, will you be my doh-nee?

column6: Will I have to pay for you? / What if I decide wrong? / But you're still healthy! / Can I really cope?
Asking is a big talk. She has worries, and I don't know what to say.
Ask Lisa works on my phone too.
Let me ask it how to start.
I've been thinking about what would happen if I cannot make decisions
What if I make the wrong decision for you?
If you're concerned about making the wrong decision, don't worry - we can discuss my wishes and values now, and they guide you should you need to make a decision
I am asking because I trust you, not because you have an obligation.
Okay. Let's talk about it properly.
Asking is easier when you know what to say. Try Ask Lisa, on your computer or your phone!
